title: CODATA 2022: the Bohr radius is 5.291 772 105 44 × 10⁻¹¹ m
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 000 82 × 10⁻¹¹ m. The atomic unit of length is the same number.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'Bohr radius 5.291 772 105 44 e-11' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 82 e-11', in metres. The line 'atomic unit of length' prints the same value and the same uncertainty. The Bohr radius is a measured derived quantity in this adjustment, not one of the seven defining constants.

sources.title: Fundamental Physical Constants, complete listing, 2022 CODATA adjustment
